rules.rule: Compilation appearance does not imply primary release authorship.
Catalogue inclusion establishes relevance only; core genre membership requires explicit evidence.
Preserve source spelling and diacritics; normalized identifiers are separate fields.
Duplicate source listings are retained as observations but deduplicated in canonical indexes.
Distinguish artist origin, label location, release country, release territory, and event location.
Distinguish release year, source observation date, founding date, active period, and event date.
